raw_text_blob: FERC issued a Show Cause order under FPA Section 206 regarding Talen Energy's Cumulus Data co-location arrangement at Susquehanna Steam Electric Station. The Commission identified concerns about net injection configurations and directed Talen to demonstrate compliance within 90 days or face a formal contract restudy. An intervening party representing industrial ratepayers has further alleged that the behind-the-meter arrangement improperly circumvents PJM's interconnection queue process.

FERC received a Section 206 complaint from the PJM Independent Market Monitor alleging that Constellation Energy's proposed nuclear co-location tariff unfairly shifts transmission cost allocation obligations from the co-located data center operator to other PJM market participants. The IMM requests a formal evidentiary hearing and interim injunctive relief pending resolution.
